naslov: AI Wars Ep. 24: Nvidia brings back Huang, SpaceX sued over xAI's Grok
opis:
Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and chair after 11 days, citing assurances from the highest levels of the US government. Trump says he spoke with the board personally, while probes continue and Huang testifies before Congress on December 1. Meanwhile, Oregon and Virginia became the first states to sue SpaceX, which took over xAI, claiming Grok still produces sexualized images of real people, including children.

naslov: Claude Ship: AI agents that review, fix and approve your GitHub PRs | AI Tool #30
opis:
Agents that review PRs on GitHub, fix failing checks and conflicts on their own, and approve changes under team rules. Code Review is generally available, and the other two agents are in beta.

How to try it:
1. You need a Claude Team or Enterprise plan and a GitHub repository
2. Open the docs at code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-ship and start with a single repository
3. Run Claude Approvals in "observe only" mode first to see what it would approve
4. Set a monthly spending limit before turning on PR Steward

Price: Team/Enterprise plan; check the link for exact pricing (there is a monthly spending limit)

Official link: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-ship

naslov: What is a zero-day? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
A zero-day is a security flaw that nobody knew about, including the people who made the software, so they've had zero days to fix it. This week, AWS described an attack where hackers' AI agents were given one goal, "get shell access," and found a zero-day in an open-source medical imaging app on their own. It took about 11 minutes.
